name: edgegap
description: Get multiplayer games online on Edgegap: dedicated servers, matchmaking, backend integration, launch and troubleshooting for Unity (including NGO, FishNet, PurrNet and Photon Fusion), Unreal Engine, Godot 4, Colyseus, Nakama, PlayFab, Three.js and Manus browser games and any other engine, driven by your coding agent.

edgegap_api_token.title: Edgegap API token
edgegap_api_token.description: Your Edgegap API token (the UUID only), from https://app.edgegap.com/user-settings?tab=tokens. Used by the hosted Edgegap MCP server to manage your apps, versions and deployments. It is organization-wide, so keep it private.
